contracts: Complete additive native proof capability; no JavaScript causal ledger, prefix hash reconstruction or metadata reset fallback.
Native export through a captured authored end excludes later review actions; retained receipts never import unknown events or grant server durability.
reviewLineageV1 requires reviewV1 and explicitly selects current-role and cursor-proof responses. Original reviewV1 response shapes remain unchanged.
Separate closed paired relay storage family contains both exact journals, local immutable versions and nonsecret progress in one atomic record; no live grants or credentials.
The durable progress getter never exposes an attempted or aborted cursor. Save failures retain native state and previous committed recovery for explicit retry.
Restored cursor prefixes are checked against actual retained Rust events before catchup can be skipped; accepted own prefixes and document writer lineage are independently verified.
The metadata adapter borrows the paired session and does not submit document edits or acquire document author leases; comment-only observers remain non-authoring document identities.
Transient network errors retry within configured bounds; fenced/denied writers do not automatically resume. Explicit reconnect may retain read-only catchup after metadata-write revocation.
Registration requires durable separate host credential storage before authoring; collisions never rename pending history.
No stored document/review event family is reinterpreted and no default editor imports or publication state changes.
